notes.title: Fix Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've just updated our game with some minor fixes you've mention.

[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect work of undressing girl in gameplay
[*] Fixed a bug with voice over in gallery
[*] Fixed a bug when all images were unlocked at the beggining of the game
[/list]

If you notice any additional bugs in the game - feel free to share them with us!

Thank you all!
